tickets.body: We run a small studio and your sync service has been corrupting our shared boards for a week. The pattern is consistent: when two editors save within the same second, one version silently overwrites the other, and the history shows no conflict. I have tested this on three machines, two networks, and both the web and desktop clients, with the same result. The export API also returns stale timestamps for about an hour after each incident, which breaks our client reporting. Our workspace admin email is ops@brightstudio.example. We need an engineering answer, not a script: is this a known race condition, what is the workaround until it is fixed, and will the corrupted versions be recoverable?
tickets.subject: Sync overwrites concurrent edits — engineering answer needed
